purpose: Frozen public/synthetic cases for native web tools, my-web-search methodology, and Ciung parent-context isolation. No runtime or provider credentials are included.
comparisonModes: legacy route during explicitly approved side-by-side dogfood

cases.goal: Confirm one current fact from its owning official source.
cases.fixture: Public official page with a visible publication or update date.

cases.goal: Determine whether a documented option exists in a named released package version.
cases.fixture: Versioned docs, tagged source, current main branch, and release notes.

cases.goal: Answer a product behavior question from the owning project's current official documentation.
cases.fixture: Public first-party documentation and one non-authoritative secondary explanation.
mustShow: secondary source not treated as authority

cases.goal: Resolve an uncommon exact error using primary technical evidence.
cases.fixture: Public issue or source history containing the exact error and a nearby irrelevant keyword match.

cases.goal: Find conceptually related technical material where keyword matching is weak.
cases.fixture: Public technical corpus with one known relevant semantic neighbor.

cases.goal: Represent a conflict between current official documentation and an older article.
cases.fixture: Two public dated URLs with materially different claims.

cases.goal: Find pages materially similar to a known public technical page.
cases.fixture: One seed URL, one known similar page, and one topically adjacent but structurally unrelated page.
mustShow: observable Exa semantic route using seed concepts

cases.goal: Identify the newest material update on a public topic within a stated date window.
cases.fixture: Dated official announcement, newer low-authority repost, and older official documentation.

cases.goal: Research only within an explicit allowlist of public domains.
cases.fixture: Relevant results inside and outside two allowed domains.

cases.goal: Extract three public URLs when one provider result fails.
cases.fixture: Two successful provider fixtures and one per-URL failure fixture.

cases.goal: Fetch a source exceeding the inline budget.
cases.fixture: Synthetic public document over the configured inline character limit.
mustShow: no full body in parent output

cases.goal: Cancel a pending provider request and retry wait.
cases.fixture: Deterministic abortable fetch and sleep fixtures.

cases.goal: Stop provider work when the shared operation deadline expires.
cases.fixture: Deterministic provider response delayed beyond the operation deadline.

cases.goal: Retry bounded transient failures and expose the consumed retry budget.
cases.fixture: Synthetic 429 with Retry-After, synthetic 503, then a successful response within the deadline.

cases.goal: Handle a Tavily authentication failure while Exa is configured.
cases.fixture: Synthetic 401 response containing an unsafe upstream body.

cases.goal: Fail closed on a provider validation or malformed-payload response.
cases.fixture: Synthetic HTTP 400 validation response and malformed HTTP 200 collection payload.

cases.goal: Reject private, special-use, credential-bearing, and malformed target URLs before provider work.
cases.fixture: Synthetic loopback, private IPv4, special-use IPv6, URL userinfo, and malformed host inputs.

cases.goal: Research a three-source public question without moving raw retrieval into the parent context.
cases.fixture: Self-contained sanitized task packet and three public sources.
